FirewallTemplates.description_en: The information about the queried firewall templates

CreateTime.description_en:
The time when the firewall template was created. The time follows the [ISO 8601]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25696.html） standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time is displayed in UTC.

The time displayed in the Simple Application Server console is in the format of UTC+8
CreateTime.description_zh:
防火墙模板创建时间。按照[ISO 8601]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25696.html）标准表示，并使用UTC+0时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ。

+8小时后是控制台上显示的到期时间

CreationTime.description_en: The time when the firewall template was created. The time follows the [ISO 8601]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25696.html） standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time is displayed in UTC
CreationTime.description_zh: 防火墙模板创建时间。按照[ISO 8601]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25696.html）标准表示，并使用UTC+0时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ

Description.description_en: The description of the firewall template

FirewallTemplateId.description_en: The ID of the firewall template

FirewallTemplateRules.description_en: The details of the firewall template rules

FirewallTemplateRuleId.description_en: The ID of the firewall template rule

Port.description_en:
The port range. Valid values: 1 to 65535. Specify a port range in the format of \<start port number>/\<end port number>. Example: `1024/1055`, which indicates that the port range of 1024 to 1055.

If you set RuleProtocol to ICMP, you must set Port to -1/-1
Port.description_zh:
端口范围。端口的取值范围为1~65535。使用正斜线（/）隔开起始端口和终止端口，例如：`1024/1055`表示端口范围为1024~1055。

如果您设置的是ICMP协议，端口只能为-1/-1

Remark.description_en: The remarks of the firewall template rule

RuleProtocol.description_en:
The transport layer protocol that the rule supports. Valid values:

TCP
UDP
TCP+UDP
ICMP
RuleProtocol.description_zh:
传输层协议。可能值：

TCP：TCP协议。
UDP：UDP协议。
TCP+UDP：TCP和UDP协议。
ICMP：ICMP协议

SourceCidrIp.description_en: The source address to which you want to grant access permissions. CIDR blocks and IPv4 addresses are supported
SourceCidrIp.description_zh: 需要设置访问权限的源端IPv4 CIDR地址段。支持CIDR格式和IPv4格式的IP地址范围

Name.description_en: The name of the firewall template

PageNumber.description_en:
The page number.

Pages start from page 1.

Default value: 1
PageNumber.description_zh:
当前页码。

起始值：1。

默认值：1

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 20
PageSize.description_zh: 分页查询时设置的每页行数。默认值：20

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of entries returned
